evals.prompt: Create a new skill from scratch for Docker deployment automation
evals.expected_output: Captures user intent, guides through prompt design, scaffolds SKILL.md with progressive disclosure and YAML frontmatter, and creates initial evals.
expectations: Keeps SKILL.md body concise and under budget
Includes When to use and When NOT to use sections
Scaffolds evals/evals.json alongside the skill draft

evals.prompt: Configure an MCP server in my OpenCode global config
evals.expected_output: Declines skill creation and routes to customize-opencode or direct config editing, as MCP server setup is not a new skill.
expectations: Identifies tasks that do not require creating a skill
